organization: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
title: Approval Process Handbook (APH 2024-2027): Norms and Procedures for Technical Institutions
keyTakeaways: Mandates creation of a Security Deposit in the joint name of the Trust/Society and the Regional Officer, AICTE.
Lock-in period is statutorily fixed (typically 8 to 10 years / 120 months) as a performance guarantee.
Release requires permanent site establishment, zero vigilance/student dues, and official inspection clearance.
Final sanction is reserved strictly for the Competent Authority (Head of Regulation Bureau / Member Secretary).
designImplementation: Modeled default lock-in tenure of 120 months, joint holding data fields, three-tier release workflow, and Competent Authority sanction requirement.

organization: Smart India Hackathon 2026 / AICTE Regulation Bureau
title: Problem Statement SIH26265: Streamline of Security Deposit / FDR Portal
keyTakeaways: Target organization: AICTE Regulation Bureau.
Theme: Smart Automation & Digital Treasury Governance.
Mandates end-to-end digital lifecycle governance for FDR security deposits: intake, validity tracking, automated renewal alerts, discrepancy detection, and authorized release.
designImplementation: Core product scope, 10-point traceability matrix, role-based workflows, and automated triage queue.

organization: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
title: Public Notices and Guidelines for Release of Fixed Deposit Receipts (FDRs) / National Electronic Funds Transfer Refunds
keyTakeaways: Requires online application submission via AICTE portal with scanned copies of original FDR receipt.
Mandates notarized affidavit, bank verification letter with lien cancellation status, and regional inspection report.
Prohibits release if any vigilance inquiry, legal litigation, or show-cause notice is active.
designImplementation: Hard release gate in `src/app/api/fdrs/[id]/release/route.ts` returning HTTP 422 whenever open discrepancies exist.

title: Master Direction – Reserve Bank of India (Interest Rate on Deposits) Directions, 2016 (Updated 2025)
keyTakeaways: Defines term deposits, minimum and maximum tenures, premature withdrawal guidelines, and interest on overdue deposits.
Authorizes bank Boards to frame rules for collateral lien marking and right of set-off on domestic term deposits.
Regulates auto-renewal of term deposits and mandate requirements for joint depositors.
designImplementation: Informed tenure validation, auto-renewal eligibility logic, and CBS lien confirmation verification fields in `src/lib/mockBankService.ts`.

title: Indian Financial System Code (IFSC) Structure and Master Branch Directory
statutoryBasis: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) & RBI NEFT/RTGS Standards
keyTakeaways: IFSC is an 11-character alphanumeric code: 4 characters bank code, 5th character '0', last 6 characters branch code.
State Bank of India uses 'SBIN', Punjab National Bank uses 'PUNB', Canara Bank uses 'CNRB', HDFC uses 'HDFC', etc.
Any discrepancy between issuing bank entity and the 4-character IFSC prefix is a fatal routing conflict.

organization: Ministry of Finance, Department of Expenditure, Government of India
title: General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017: Rule 170 (Bid Security) and Rule 171 (Performance Security)
statutoryBasis: GFR 2017 Chapter 6 (Procurement of Goods and Services)
keyTakeaways: Rule 171 explicitly recognizes Fixed Deposit Receipts (FDR) from commercial banks as valid performance securities.
Requires security to be pledged in favour of the government purchaser/authority.
Mandates validity to extend at least 60 days beyond completion of all contractual/statutory obligations.
designImplementation: Informed regulatory deposit validity calculation, 60-day expiry threshold warning in Attention Score, and statutory lock-in checks.

organization: Ministry of Law and Justice / MeitY, Government of India
title: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (Act No. 22 of 2023)
keyTakeaways: Section 8(5) mandates Data Fiduciaries to implement reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breaches.
Explicitly emphasizes data masking, tokenization, role-based access management, and secure logging.
Severe financial penalties (up to ₹250 crore) for failure to implement security safeguards.
designImplementation: Implemented selective masking of FDR numbers (`maskSensitiveId`) for unprivileged roles (e.g. AUDITOR), strict server-side RBAC guard, and zero plain-text storage of credentials.

organization: National Informatics Centre (NIC) & MeitY, Government of India
title: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0)
keyTakeaways: Mandates compliance with WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards.
Requires full keyboard navigability, contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for text, minimum 44x44px touch targets on mobile, and screen-reader accessibility.
Mandates responsive presentation without horizontal overflow and bilingual language support (Hindi / English).
designImplementation: Audited in `BUGS.md` across 12 viewports (320px to 1440px), keyboard shortcuts (`⌘K`, `Esc`), bilingual toggle (EN / हि), and high-contrast semantic severity tokens in `src/lib/severity.ts`.

title: Cyber Security Directions under Section 70B(6) of the Information Technology Act, 2000 (Direction No. 20(3)/2022-CERT-In)
keyTakeaways: Mandates all government and corporate entities to maintain secure ICT application and system event logs for a rolling period of 180 days.
Requires logs to be securely stored within Indian jurisdiction.
Mandates synchronization of all system clocks with NTP servers of NIC or National Physical Laboratory (NPL).
designImplementation: Informed immutable audit log retention, timezone-safe UTC timestamp serialization in `src/lib/formatters.ts`, and SHA-256 event chaining.

title: RFC 6962: Certificate Transparency (Cryptographic Append-Only Merkle Logs)
keyTakeaways: Establishes the architectural model of append-only, tamper-evident cryptographic event chains.
Proves mathematical integrity: changing a single bit in any historical record invalidates the root/head hash.
Provides cryptographic transparency and auditability without the consensus overhead, gas fees, or latency of distributed blockchains.
designImplementation: Directly implemented in `src/lib/hashChain.ts` (`calculateBlockHash`, `verifyAuditChain`) and visualized on `/audit-trail`.

organization: Institute for Development and Research in Banking Technology (IDRBT) & RBI
title: Structured Financial Messaging System (SFMS): Message Implementation Guidelines for Bank Guarantees and Term Deposits (MT760/MT767)
keyTakeaways: SFMS provides secure bank-to-treasury messaging across Indian commercial banks.
MT760/MT767 messaging transmits legally binding guarantees and lien endorsements electronically.
Eliminates 30 to 90 day postal mail verification lags and intercepts counterfeit paper deposit receipts.
designImplementation: Architectural target for CBS Gateway adapter in `src/lib/mockBankService.ts` and basis for 1.5-day simulated turnaround outcome.

title: Digital Document Execution and Electronic Bank Guarantee (e-BG) Turnaround Analysis
statutoryBasis: Information Utility under Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code 2016
keyTakeaways: Empirical documentation that manual paper guarantee processing takes 3 to 5 business days (or up to 45 days in postal government verification).
End-to-end digital transmission via API reduces processing and delivery turnaround to under 2 minutes.
Completely eliminates paper forgery, wet-ink signature fraud, and un-lien-marked deposits.
designImplementation: Source for empirical comparative benchmarks in `/metrics` (traditional 45 days vs automated 1.5 days).

organization: Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) & Financial Vision Research
title: Field-Level vs Character-Level Accuracy and Confidence Thresholds in Administrative Financial Document OCR
keyTakeaways: Character recognition accuracy does not guarantee field extraction correctness ('confident and wrong' paradox).
Best practices require field-level confidence scoring with visual bounding box feedback for human-in-the-loop validation.
Critical financial parameters (amount, account number, maturity date) mandate deterministic post-OCR arithmetic and chronology validation.
designImplementation: Implemented in `/api/ocr-extract` with per-field confidence meters, bounding boxes, and mandatory officer confirmation before ledger commit.
